stations.title: Maeve
stations.say: Let's get rid of the clutter.

stations.title: Studio folder
stations.text: A duplicate, printer leftovers, an old site.
stations.note: The logo is inside the old site.

captions: At Ashgrove, Maeve wants the last clutter gone, except the old logo.
A duplicate, printer leftovers and an old site remain, and the logo sits inside it.
You clear the clutter and keep the logo, in four tasks.
The clutter is gone for good, and the logo is safe in artwork.
The studio laptop is sorted, and nothing that mattered was lost.
